items.title: Objection (Einspruch) against Kindergeld assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterfulda erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated (posting day) 19.11.2026 (Thursday), no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date stated. Familienkasse decisions follow the tax-office delivery-fiction rule (4th day after posting, moved to the next working day if that falls on a weekend/holiday, §108 Abs.3 AO analog). Counting from 19.11.2026: day 1 = 20.11 (Fri), day 2 = 21.11 (Sat), day 3 = 22.11 (Sun), day 4 = 23.11 (Mon) — a normal working day, so no shift is needed; delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 23.11.2026. One-month Einspruch period per §355 Abs.1 AO / §188 Abs.2 BGB: ends on the day with the same number in the following month, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday), which is neither a weekend day nor a public holiday in NW, so no further shift applies.

items.title: Submit new certificate of enrollment (Studienbescheinigung) for the summer semester
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie uns zum Ende des Sommersemesters eine neue Studienbescheinigung ein.
